_help: SAFT (Simple Agreement for Future Tokens) template. Fields become the form; {{key}} in the text is replaced with what the visitor types. Blank fields show as [Field label]. A plain starting point only: it must be reviewed by a qualified lawyer, and in many countries selling a SAFT is a regulated securities offering.
title: Simple Agreement for Future Tokens (SAFT)

fields.label: Paid in

sections.title: Parties
text: This Simple Agreement for Future Tokens (the "Agreement") is made on {{date}} between {{company}}, registered in {{companyJurisdiction}}, of {{companyAddress}} (the "Company"), and {{investor}}, of {{investorAddress}} (the "Investor").

sections.title: 1. Purchase
text: The Investor pays the Company {{amount}} (the "Purchase Amount"), {{payment}}, on or before the date of this Agreement.
In return, the Company will deliver tokens called {{token}} (the "Tokens") to the Investor when the network launches, in line with this Agreement.

sections.title: 2. Number of Tokens
text: The number of Tokens is the Purchase Amount divided by the token price, which is {{price}}.
The Company will tell the Investor the final number of Tokens in writing before delivery.

sections.title: 3. Delivery, lockup and vesting
text: The Company will deliver the Tokens to a wallet address the Investor gives in writing.
The Tokens are subject to this lockup and vesting: {{lockup}}. The Investor may not sell or transfer locked Tokens.

sections.title: 4. If the network does not launch
text: If the network has not launched within {{deadline}}, or the Company stops the project, the Company will return to the Investor the unused part of the Purchase Amount, as far as it is able to.
The Investor understands that the Company may not have enough money left to return the full Purchase Amount.

sections.title: 5. Investor statements
text: The Investor confirms that:
(a) it is allowed to buy the Tokens under the laws that apply to it, including any investor qualification rules;
(b) it is buying for itself and not to resell to the public;
(c) it understands that the Tokens may lose all their value, may never be listed or traded, and that it could lose the whole Purchase Amount;
(d) the money used is not from crime, and it is not on any sanctions list.

sections.title: 6. Company statements
text: The Company confirms that it is properly set up under the laws of {{companyJurisdiction}}, has the authority to sign this Agreement, and will use the Purchase Amount to build the network and the project.

sections.title: 7. No shares, no promises
text: This Agreement does not give the Investor shares, voting rights, profit rights or any other rights in the Company.
The Company does not promise any price, return, listing or profit from the Tokens.

sections.title: 8. Taxes
text: Each party pays its own taxes that arise from this Agreement.

sections.title: 9. Governing law
text: This Agreement is governed by the {{law}}. Any dispute goes to the courts or arbitration named under that law.

sections.title: 10. Whole agreement
text: This Agreement is the whole agreement between the parties about the Tokens. Any change must be in writing and signed by both parties.
